# sonarqube_github_configuration (Resource)

GitHub authentication and provisioning, through a GitHub App. SonarQube has one such configuration; destroying the resource deletes it. It is stored in the `sonar.auth.github.*` settings, which must not also be managed with `sonarqube_setting`. Import ID: the configuration ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Log in with GitHub, and provision the members and teams of one
# organization automatically (a commercial edition is needed for that).
# The *_wo arguments keep credentials out of state (Terraform 1.11+).
resource "sonarqube_github_configuration" "main" {
  enabled                = true
  application_id         = "123456"
  client_id              = "Iv1.0123456789abcdef"
  client_secret_wo       = var.github_client_secret
  private_key_wo         = var.github_private_key
  credentials_wo_version = "1"
  allowed_organizations  = ["my-org"]
  provisioning_type      = "AUTO_PROVISIONING"
}

variable "github_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

variable "github_private_key" {
  description = "PEM private key of the GitHub App."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  ephemeral   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) App ID of the GitHub App.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID of the GitHub App.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether users can log in with GitHub.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allow_users_to_sign_up` (Boolean) With `JIT`, whether users who do not exist in SonarQube yet can sign up. Defaults to the server's choice.
- `allowed_organizations` (Set of String) Organizations whose members can log in. Empty allows members of any organization the GitHub App is installed in.
- `api_url` (String) API URL: `https://api.github.com/`, or `https://github.example.com/api/v3/` for GitHub Enterprise.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of the GitHub App. Stored in state; prefer `client_secret_wo`. SonarQube does not return it, so drift cannot be detected.
- `client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only form of `client_secret`, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `credentials_wo_version` to apply a new value.
- `credentials_wo_version` (String) Any value; changing it applies the current values of the `_wo` arguments.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Private key (PEM) of the GitHub App. Stored in state; prefer `private_key_wo`. SonarQube does not return it, so drift cannot be detected.
- `private_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only form of `private_key`, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `credentials_wo_version` to apply a new value.
- `project_visibility` (Boolean) With `AUTO_PROVISIONING`, make provisioned projects public or private like their repository; otherwise they are private. Defaults to the server's choice.
- `provisioning_type` (String) `JIT` creates users at their first login. `AUTO_PROVISIONING` synchronizes the users and teams of the allowed organizations with SonarQube hourly; it needs Developer edition or above.
- `synchronize_groups` (Boolean) With `JIT`, add users at login to the SonarQube groups named like their GitHub groups or teams.
- `web_url` (String) Web URL: `https://github.com/`, or `https://github.example.com/` for GitHub Enterprise.

### Read-Only

- `error_message` (String) Why SonarQube considers the configuration invalid, if it does.
- `id` (String) Configuration ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_github_configuration.example 'github-configuration'
```
